title: user.kyc_level_updated
description: An operator moved a user between KYC levels. The withdrawal policy reads the level on each request, so the next withdrawal is decided under the new level's limits; nothing already pending is re-decided. No account_id and no sequence: a user is not an account.

version.description: User row version after the change; increases on every edit.

reason.description: Operator's reason, recorded in the audit trail.
